facts.business: Rama Vision Limited is a diversified FMCG enterprise engaged in the import, distribution, and marketing of consumer products across Mother & Baby Care, Personal Care, Skincare, and Food segments.

segments.name: Mother & Baby Care, Personal Care, Skincare and Food

key_risks: Foreign currency exchange rate fluctuations due to significant imports from overseas principal suppliers
Volatility in key input prices, transportation and logistics costs
facts.related_party_note: Transactions with Directors, KMPs, relatives, RVL Exim Limited, and Rama Vision Limited Group Gratuity Trust. Key transactions include remuneration to Directors/KMPs (Satish Jain: Rs 136.19 lacs, Arhant Jain: Rs 123.71 lacs, Udit Jain: Rs 111.04 lacs, etc.), rent paid to Sudha Jain (Rs 63.31 lacs), and rent security deposit of Rs 8.97 lacs outstanding. Unsecured loans received and repaid from Satish Jain in prior year (Rs 120 lacs).
